title: Conditional 1: The Hypothetical (если бы + past, past + бы)
description: Russian builds the conditional out of past-tense forms plus the particle бы. One structure covers past, present, and future hypotheticals. The if-clause uses если бы; the result-clause uses бы after the verb.
descriptionRussian: Условное наклонение строится из прошедшего времени и частицы бы. Одна структура покрывает прошлое, настоящее и будущее в гипотетическом смысле. Если-предложение использует «если бы», главное — «бы» после глагола.
intro: The Russian conditional is startlingly economical. English has a different shape for every time frame: if I know, if I knew, if I had known. Russian has one, built from past-tense forms plus a small particle, and context supplies the rest. That particle is the whole hypothetical marker, and without it the same sentence reports something that really happened.
rules: Structure: 'Если бы + past, [subject] бы + past.' Both verbs are past-tense forms; бы is the hypothetical marker and appears in both clauses.
One past + бы construction covers past, present, and future hypotheticals. The form does not change; context picks the English reading.
Position of бы: in the if-clause it attaches to если ('если бы'); in the result-clause it sits right after the subject or right after the verb.
Use past-tense forms only, never present or future. Если бы я знал (correct), not если бы я знаю / буду знать.
Без бы the same past forms describe real events (Я знал = I knew); с бы they become hypothetical (Я бы знал = I would know / would have known).
examples: Если бы я знал её адрес, я бы написал ей. (If I knew / had known her address, I would write / would have written to her.) Impf state verb знал + pf single-event написал.
Если бы ты прочитал статью, ты бы согласился со мной. (If you had read the article through, you would have agreed with me.) Two perfectives: completed reading, completed agreement.
Если бы у нас был свободный вечер, мы бы пошли в кино. (If we had a free evening, we would go to the cinema.) Impf state быть + pf single-event пойти.
Если бы Лена услышала звонок, она бы открыла дверь. (If Lena had heard the bell, she would have opened the door.) Two perfectives: a single hearing event + a single opening event.
Если бы Антон спал лучше, он бы чувствовал себя бодрее. (If Anton slept better, he would feel more rested.) Two imperfectives: ongoing sleep, ongoing feeling.
Если бы я мог тебе помочь, я бы помог. (If I could help you, I would.) Impf modal мочь + pf single-event помочь.

rows.label: Real (genuine possibility)
cells: Если завтра будет дождь, я останусь дома.

rows.label: Hypothetical past
cells: Если бы я знал, я бы сказал.

rows.label: Hypothetical present
cells: Если бы я знал её адрес сейчас, я бы написал.

rows.label: Hypothetical future

items.prompt: Если бы я _____ её адрес, я бы написал ей.
items.promptEnglish: If I had known her address, I would have written to her.
items.hint: Знать is an impf-only state verb. Past masc form with бы?
items.explanation: Знать is an impf-only state verb (recap from A2 Aspect Intro Lesson 6) and stays imperfective in the conditional. Past masc form: знал. The result-clause supplies бы before написал. The distractor узнал means 'found out, recognised' and is a different lexical event.

items.prompt: Если бы ты _____ книгу, ты бы понял мою точку зрения.
items.promptEnglish: If you had read the book through, you would have understood my point of view.
items.hint: One specific book + an implied completion. Past form, which aspect?
items.explanation: The if-clause hypothesises a single completed event (reading the book through), so the perfective past прочитал. Читал would describe an ongoing process of reading, which the result-clause ('would have understood') does not depend on.

items.prompt: Если бы у нас _____ свободный вечер, мы бы пошли в кино.
items.promptEnglish: If we had a free evening, we would go to the cinema.
items.hint: У + gen + nom subject. Past form of быть, masculine to agree with 'вечер.'
items.explanation: The if-clause says 'we had a free evening' with the possession frame 'у нас + был.' In a hypothetical conditional, the past-tense form of быть is required: был (masc, agreeing with 'свободный вечер'). The real-conditional будет or the present есть would describe a genuine possibility, not a hypothetical.

items.prompt: Если бы Лена _____ звонок, она бы открыла дверь.
items.promptEnglish: If Lena had heard the bell, she would have opened the door.
items.hint: A single moment of hearing the bell. Past fem form, perfective.
items.explanation: The if-clause hypothesises a single moment of hearing the bell, which would have triggered the opening. Perfective past fem of услышать: услышала. Слышала (impf) would describe ongoing hearing, which the result 'would have opened' does not require.

items.prompt: Если бы Антон _____ лучше, он бы чувствовал себя бодрее.
items.promptEnglish: If Anton slept better, he would feel more rested.
items.hint: Ongoing sleep is the cue. Past masc impf form.
items.explanation: The if-clause describes a hypothetical ongoing state ('slept better, generally'). Imperfective past masc спал. The result-clause's чувствовал is also impf (ongoing state). Поспал would frame a single bounded nap, which the 'feeling rested in general' result does not require.

items.prompt: Если бы я _____ тебе помочь, я бы помог.
items.promptEnglish: If I could help you, I would.
items.hint: Мочь is impf and ongoing here. Past masc form.
items.explanation: The if-clause hypothesises an ongoing capacity to help, expressed by the impf modal мочь. Past masc impf: мог. The result-clause supplies a single helping event with the perfective помог. Смог (pf) would frame a single moment of managing to help, which the speaker is not framing here.

items.prompt: Если бы у меня было время, _____.
items.promptEnglish: If I had time, I would walk in the park.
items.explanation: The hypothetical result is past + бы: я бы гулял. Without бы it reports a real habit; гуляю and буду гулять are non-past forms, which бы never combines with.

items.promptEnglish: If Anton knew the answer, he would help us.
items.hint: State verb in the if-clause, single event in the result.
items.explanation: The result clause takes past + бы: он бы помог нам. Without бы it becomes a real past report; поможет is future, which cannot carry бы.

items.promptEnglish: If the weather were nice, we would drive out of town.
items.hint: The result clause with a plural subject.
items.explanation: Past + бы: мы бы поехали за город. Bare поехали reports a real trip; поедем is future; the infinitive поехать cannot serve as the clause's verb.

items.prompt: _____ твой номер, я бы позвонил тебе.
items.promptEnglish: If I had your phone number, I would call you.
items.hint: Possession frame in the if-clause: agree with номер.
items.explanation: The if-clause is если бы + past, and был agrees with masculine номер: Если бы у меня был твой номер. Было would be neuter; будет is future; bare если makes it a real condition.

items.promptEnglish: If you had read the letter, you would have understood everything.
items.hint: Two completed events, each with its бы.
items.explanation: Both clauses are hypothetical, so the result also takes past + бы: ты бы понял всё. Without бы it turns into a real report; поймёшь and понимаешь are non-past forms.

blanks: Если бы я _____ её, я бы поздоровался. (If I had seen her, I would have said hello.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: The if-clause hypothesises a single moment of seeing her (which would have triggered the greeting). Perfective past masc увидел. Видел (impf) would describe ongoing seeing-her, which the bounded result 'would have said hello' does not require.

sentenceBuilding.answer: Если бы я знал правду, я бы сказал тебе
sentenceBuilding.translation: If I had known the truth, I would have told you.
acceptableVariants: Если бы я знал правду, я сказал бы тебе
sentenceBuilding.hint: If-clause: 'если бы' + past. Result-clause: subject + 'бы' + past.

sentenceBuilding.answer: Если бы у нас было время, мы бы погуляли
sentenceBuilding.translation: If we had time, we would take a walk.
acceptableVariants: Если бы у нас было время, мы погуляли бы
sentenceBuilding.hint: Possession frame 'у нас + было'; both clauses carry бы.

sentenceBuilding.answer: Если бы Лена увидела сообщение, она бы ответила
sentenceBuilding.translation: If Lena had seen the message, she would have answered.
acceptableVariants: Если бы Лена увидела сообщение, она ответила бы
sentenceBuilding.hint: Two single events: a perfective seeing + a perfective answering. Past fem forms.

sentenceBuilding.answer: Если бы ты спросил раньше, я бы помог
sentenceBuilding.translation: If you had asked earlier, I would have helped.
acceptableVariants: Если бы ты спросил раньше, я помог бы
sentenceBuilding.hint: If-clause perfective спросил; result-clause subject 'я' + 'бы' + помог.

errorCorrection.sentence: Если бы мы знаем дорогу, мы бы не заблудились.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: If we had known the way, we wouldn't have gotten lost.
errorCorrection.explanation: The conditional 'если бы ...' is built from a PAST-tense form, never the present: знали. Знаем, знаете, and знают are all present-tense forms, which belong to real statements ('Мы знаем дорогу' = we know the way), not to a hypothetical frame. The бы attached to 'если' already marks the clause as non-actual; the verb must be past to match. One past + бы construction covers past, present, and future hypotheticals alike.

errorCorrection.sentence: Если бы завтра будет хорошая погода, мы бы поехали за город.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: If the weather were good tomorrow, we would go out of town.
errorCorrection.explanation: Even for a FUTURE hypothetical, Russian uses the past-tense form with бы, not the future: была (fem, agreeing with погода). Будет is the future form used in REAL conditionals ('Если завтра будет хорошая погода' = if it actually is nice, a genuine possibility), which clashes with the hypothetical 'мы бы поехали'. Есть (present) and будут (future plural) likewise do not fit the past + бы frame. One past + бы construction serves past, present, and future hypotheticals.

errorCorrection.sentence: Если бы Антон закрывал окно, в комнате было бы теплее.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: If Anton had closed the window, it would be warmer in the room.
errorCorrection.explanation: Aspect in the conditional follows the past-tense rules. The if-clause hypothesises a single completed action (closing the window once), which would have made the room warmer, so the perfective past: закрыл. The imperfective закрывал would describe a repeated or ongoing closing, which the one-result frame does not need.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: If I knew / had known, I would say / would have said.
minimalPairs.explanation: The result-clause 'я бы сказал' carries бы, so the whole sentence is in the hypothetical frame. The if-clause must match: если бы (with бы attached to если). Если alone introduces a real conditional, which would clash with the hypothetical 'я бы сказал.'

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I would help if I could.
minimalPairs.explanation: The result-clause needs the hypothetical particle бы to match the conditional if-clause 'если бы мог.' Уже is a completion adverb that would clash with the hypothetical frame (the helping has not actually happened, by hypothesis).

reviewVocab.definition: the conditional mood (built from past-tense forms plus the particle бы; one form covers past, present, and future hypotheticals)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Если бы я знал, я бы сказал' оба глагола стоят в условном наклонении.

reviewVocab.definition: if (only) (introduces a hypothetical if-clause; followed by a past-tense verb; бы attaches to если and stays there)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Если бы Лена услышала звонок, она бы открыла дверь' конструкция 'если бы' открывает гипотетическое условие.

reviewVocab.definition: the hypothetical particle (unstressed; converts a past-tense verb to its hypothetical reading; appears in both clauses of a conditional)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Я бы помог' частица бы делает форму помог гипотетической, а не реальной.
